decisions.reason: The metro data centre connection network builds directly on the firm's owned fibre and carrier-neutral data centre expertise, and its early customer adoption gives the firm results it can interpret and use to expand the service.
Optical spectrum connectivity extends the firm's core fibre engineering knowledge into the high-bandwidth services at the centre of its strategy, so the firm is well placed to keep improving it.
The number ordering portal draws on the firm's software platforms and regulatory know-how and supports real-time provisioning, though it may later be folded into broader self-service portals.

Direct voice network connection builds on established voice infrastructure and serves enterprises moving to cloud telephony, although voice is a declining segment, as the earlier withdrawal of carrier pre-selection showed.
